title: qa checklist: studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring expects a count roll-up to carry summaryOperations.field, which #27533 makes optional
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 from the triage contract review of PR #27533 (#27462, comment 6496620533, ③-2), a checklist-author follow-up. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Observed

PR #27533 lets a `count` roll-up save without `summaryOperations.field` (the spec's own describe already said `field` is ignored for count). The QA checklist item that found the bug, `studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` (~:2831), still says in acceptance clause 3 "saved spec-valid: summaryOperations { object, field, function }", and its verify step expects both summaries to carry "the authored object, field and function". Once #27533 lands, a correct run (the count carries no `field`) scores as a failure.

## Wanted

After PR #27533 merges: revise the item (revision 3) so the count summary carries `object` and `function` with no `field`, and the sum summary still carries all three.

## Dedupe words

summary-field-authoring checklist count rollup field summaryOperations revision
